    8| def truncate(text: str, limit: int, suffix: str = DEFAULT_SUFFIX) -> str:
    9|     """Shorten ``text`` so it fits within ``limit`` characters.
   10| 
   11|     When the text is longer than ``limit`` it is cut and ``suffix`` is appended
   12|     to show that content was removed.
   13| 
   14|     Args:
   15|         text: Input text.
   16|         limit: Maximum length of the returned string, including ``suffix``.
   17|         suffix: Marker appended when the text was shortened.
   18| 
   19|     Returns:
   20|         The original text when it already fits, otherwise a shortened version.
   21| 
   22|     Raises:
   23|         ValueError: If ``limit`` is negative.
   24|     """
   25|     if limit < 0:
   26|         raise ValueError("limit must not be negative")
   27|     if len(text) <= limit:
   28|         return text
   29|     return text[:limit] + suffix

    6| def display_width(text: str) -> int:
    7|     """Return the number of terminal columns ``text`` occupies.
    8|

   11| 
   12|     Returns:
   13|         The display width in columns.
   14|     """
   15|     return len(text)
   16| 
   17| 
   18| def pad(text: str, width: int, align: str = "left") -> str:
   19|     """Pad ``text`` with spaces so it occupies ``width`` display columns.
   20| 
   21|     Text that already occupies ``width`` columns or more is returned unchanged.
   22| 
   23|     Args:
   24|         text: Input text.
   25|         width: Target display width in columns.
   26|         align: ``"left"``, ``"right"`` or ``"center"``.
   27| 
   28|     Returns:
   29|         The padded text.
   30|     """
   31|     gap = width - len(text)
   32|     if gap <= 0:
   33|         return text
   34|     if align == "right":
   35|         return " " * gap + text
   36|     if align == "center":
   37|         left = (gap + 1) // 2
   38|         return " " * left + text + " " * (gap - left)
